name: llm-gateway-proxy
description: Cloudflare Worker that validates Microsoft Entra JWTs and proxies requests to Cloudflare AI Gateway.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare account ID. Found in the dashboard URL or **Workers & Pages → Overview**. Used to build the AI Gateway request path.

GATEWAY_NAME.description: The name of your [AI Gateway](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/) (AI Gateway → your gateway). Defaults to `main`.

CF_AIG_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare AI Gateway authentication token. Create one under your gateway's **Settings → Authenticated Gateway**, then enable authentication.

ENTRA_TENANT_ID.description: Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) **tenant ID** (a UUID). Inbound tokens must be issued by `login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant>/v2.0`.

ENTRA_CLIENT_ID.description: Microsoft Entra **App Registration client ID** (a UUID). Used as the expected `aud` (audience) claim on inbound tokens.
